result.intro_en: Two weeks bookended by big names at the Corn Exchange – Simon Amstell, Alice Cooper, Nish Kumar – and, right in the middle, Cambridge remembers its most famous lost son: Syd Barrett would have turned 80 this month, and the city marks it with a tribute concert, a small exhibition and even a football match played in his sister's name.

items.blurb_en: A concert marking what would have been Syd Barrett's 80th birthday, with Kula Shaker and Soft Machine among the artists performing his songs, plus a light show by The Mad Alchemist. It's held at the Corn Exchange, where Barrett gave his last live performance in February 1972; proceeds go to mental health charities.

Площадка выбрана не случайно — именно здесь Барретт дал своё последнее концертное выступление в феврале 1972 года; сборы пойдут на благотворительность в поддержку психического здоровья.
